The only reported failure is an ERC error: `Mnd` has W = 0.395 µm, below the 0.42 µm minimum. I widened it to W = 0.42 µm and lengthened it to L = 0.16 µm, which keeps its W/L ratio at about the same value as before. The mirror ratio becomes (2.625/13.33)/(2.0/0.15) ≈ 0.197 (previously 0.1975), so the bias current stays at about 0.985 µA instead of 0.99 µA. Load current, power, and output DC level should be essentially unchanged. I haven't re-simulated, so the other specs are unverified until the netlist runs again.

```spice
.subckt dut vin vout vdd vss ibias
* Input NMOS common source, gate at vin = 0.75 V
* L raised 0.15 -> 0.21 to cut gds (~0.7x) -> gain up, f3db still >25 MHz
* W/L kept ~0.94x previous (current trimmed ~6% for power)
M1 vout vin vss vss nfet W=9.2 L=0.21 m=1

* PMOS active load, L=0.21, W/L = 300 (unchanged ratio) -> ~71 uA
* Output DC point unchanged because M1 and M2 scale together
M2 vout vbp vdd vdd pfet W=63 L=0.21 m=1

* Bias branch: NMOS sink mirrored from IREF at ~0.197x (~0.985 uA)
* W raised to 0.42 um (SKY130 minimum); L raised 0.15 -> 0.16 to keep
* W/L ratio (2.625) and mirror ratio (~0.197 vs 0.1975) unchanged
Mnd vbp ibias vss vss nfet W=0.42 L=0.16 m=1

* PMOS diode sets load gate voltage vbp
* W/L = 4.13 (same as before), L=0.21 to match M2; mirror ratio M2/Mpd = 72.6
Mpd vbp vbp vdd vdd pfet W=0.867 L=0.21 m=1

* Reference: diode-connected NMOS, sinks IREF (5 uA, supplied by testbench)
Mb ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2.0 L=0.15 m=1
.ends
```
